The concept

A full page, built around the favourites

This demo turns the dishes named on the public menu into a complete visit — menu, gallery, and directions in one place.

The menu above lists dishes from the restaurant's public menu, and every photo on this page is illustrative stock — not photography of this business. What this concept adds is structure: the favourites up front, the visit details in one place, and a clear next step at the bottom.

Brown Brothers BBQ runs a walk-in store in Canastota plus a food truck and catering for events. If anything here looks out of date, the fastest check is a phone call — hours, availability, and the day's specials are best confirmed directly.
